knobs.name: countT0
knobs.what: s: second the first dot of the orbit cloud arrives (the count-in runs to countT1)

knobs.name: countT1
knobs.what: s: second the last dot lands and the count is read (count.at; keep at or before 26)

knobs.name: earthT0
knobs.what: s: start of the camera push to the Earth pair

knobs.name: earthT1
knobs.what: s: end of the push to the Earth pair (labels wait for it)

knobs.name: backT0
knobs.what: s: start of the pull-back to the whole cube

knobs.name: backT1
knobs.what: s: end of the pull-back

knobs.name: m1T0
knobs.what: s: the cut: axes re-label and the dots start to slide from place to spin

knobs.name: m1T1
knobs.what: s: the dots have landed on their orbit specks

knobs.name: m3T0
knobs.what: s: start of the dolly in and the section plane

knobs.name: m3T1
knobs.what: s: end of the dolly and the section

knobs.name: m2T0
knobs.what: s: start of the second cut (shells to energy layers) and the quarter turn

knobs.name: m2T1
knobs.what: s: the dots have landed in their layers

knobs.name: panT0
knobs.what: s: start of the pan to the second glass box

knobs.name: panT1
knobs.what: s: end of the pan

knobs.name: netT0
knobs.what: s: first training dot arrives

knobs.name: netT1
knobs.what: s: last training dot lands (the second count is read)

knobs.name: m4T0
knobs.what: s: the cut again, in the second box: weights to the sums that should not change

knobs.name: m4T1
knobs.what: s: the training dots have landed

knobs.name: wideT0
knobs.what: s: start of the pull-back to both boxes

knobs.name: wideT1
knobs.what: s: end of the pull-back

knobs.name: rpAt
knobs.what: s: pin: closest distance

knobs.name: vpAt
knobs.what: s: pin: speed there

knobs.name: raAt
knobs.what: s: pin: farthest distance

knobs.name: vaAt
knobs.what: s: pin: speed there

knobs.name: fbAt
knobs.what: s: the formula appears and binds (closest end)

knobs.name: fbFlyAt
knobs.what: s: the two numbers fly into the formula

knobs.name: fbResAt
knobs.what: s: the product is computed (closest)

knobs.name: fb2At
knobs.what: s: the same formula for the farthest end

knobs.name: fb2ResAt
knobs.what: s: the product is computed (farthest)

knobs.name: apartAt
knobs.what: s: the two products are set side by side

knobs.name: hiAt
knobs.what: s: one orbit is lit in the tangle (ellipse, spin arrow)

knobs.name: arrowAt
knobs.what: s: pin on the spin arrow

knobs.name: specksAt
knobs.what: s: pin: the specks

knobs.name: shellsAt
knobs.what: s: pin: the shells

knobs.name: trillionAt
knobs.what: s: callout: spin and energy inside one orbit

knobs.name: cutReadAt
knobs.what: s: readout of the lit orbits

knobs.name: layersAt
knobs.what: s: pin: the layers

knobs.name: plateAt
knobs.what: s: plate: rotation gives shells, time gives layers

knobs.name: formulaAt
knobs.what: s: plate: the sum that should not change, as type

knobs.name: netShellsAt
knobs.what: s: pin: the training shells

knobs.name: wAt
knobs.what: s: readout: how far the weights travelled

knobs.name: cAt
knobs.what: s: readout: how far the fixed sum moved

knobs.name: ratioAt
knobs.what: s: callout: about 250 times less

knobs.name: kelvinAt
knobs.what: s: the smoke ring (wordless plate) appears

knobs.name: ringR
knobs.what: world units: radius of the smoke ring in the wordless plate

knobs.name: qAt
knobs.what: s: Monday question as set type

knobs.name: honestAt
knobs.what: s: the honest line, on stage, as set type

knobs.name: camFov
knobs.what: degrees: vertical field of view (fixed inside a move)

knobs.name: camAz
knobs.what: degrees: azimuth of the main view (keep 5 to 85 so the label corner stays)

knobs.name: camEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the main view

knobs.name: camDist
knobs.what: world units: distance to the glass box in the main view (bigger = smaller box)

knobs.name: camLookY
knobs.what: world units: aims below the box centre so the box sits higher on the sheet

knobs.name: camShift
knobs.what: sheet units: how far the box sits right of centre (leaves the left column for words)

knobs.name: earthDist
knobs.what: world units: distance to the Earth pair

knobs.name: earthShiftY
knobs.what: world units: aims below the pair so it sits high and the formula fits under it

knobs.name: m3Dist
knobs.what: world units: distance at the end of the dolly in

knobs.name: m2Az
knobs.what: degrees: the quarter turn of the layers move (negative = back toward the front)

knobs.name: m2El
knobs.what: degrees: elevation after the layers move

knobs.name: wideDist
knobs.what: world units: distance of the wide frame with both boxes

knobs.name: wideEl
knobs.what: degrees: elevation of the wide frame

knobs.name: wideShiftY
knobs.what: world units: aims above the boxes so they sit low and the question fits above

knobs.name: ambAmp
knobs.what: degrees: amplitude of the slow ambient sway (0 = still)

knobs.name: ambPeriod
knobs.what: s: period of the ambient sway

knobs.name: cubeS
knobs.what: world units: edge of a glass box

knobs.name: boxGap
knobs.what: world units: distance between the two glass boxes

knobs.name: dotR
knobs.what: world units: radius of an orbit dot

knobs.name: dotRNet
knobs.what: world units: radius of a training dot

knobs.name: sizeCue
knobs.what: 0 to 1: extra size for near dots (depth cue)

knobs.name: fogMax
knobs.what: 0 to 0.3: fog toward the ground on the far side (manager level cap)

knobs.name: lyrGap
knobs.what: world units: gap between energy layers

knobs.name: stagger
knobs.what: 0 to 0.25: how much the shells start one after another in a slide

knobs.name: glassOp
knobs.what: 0 to 0.2: opacity of the glass panels behind the dots

knobs.name: gridOp
knobs.what: 0 to 0.8: opacity of the floor grid

knobs.name: earthK
knobs.what: world units per million km: size of the Earth pair (not to scale by design)

knobs.name: earthDotK
knobs.what: times: radius of the Earth and Sun marks against an orbit dot

knobs.name: dimEarth
knobs.what: 0 to 1: how far the cloud fades toward the ground during the Earth close-up

knobs.name: dimGhost
knobs.what: 0 to 1: how far the first box fades once the camera leaves it

knobs.name: dimHonest
knobs.what: 0 to 1: how far both clouds fade under the honest line

knobs.name: cutDim
knobs.what: 0 to 1: how far the dots outside the section fade (they never leave)

knobs.name: planeOp
knobs.what: 0 to 0.4: opacity of the section plane

knobs.name: labHold
knobs.what: frames: how long a pin must be pushed before it hides (gl-labels)

knobs.name: labLeader
knobs.what: sheet units: pin leader length

knobs.name: readSize
knobs.what: sheet units: size of the big readouts (floor 28)

knobs.name: plateSize
knobs.what: sheet units: size of the set-type plates

knobs.name: pinSub
knobs.what: sheet units: size of the small line under a pin (floor 14)
